app_store_connect._where: App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API > Team Keys (or Individual Keys: then omit issuer_id)
app_store_connect.vendor_number: optional, for sales/finance reports (App Store Connect > Payments and Financial Reports)

app_store_server._where: App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > In-App Purchase keys

music._where: developer.apple.com > Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles > Keys > key with 'Media Services (MusicKit)' enabled
music.user_token: optional Music User Token for /v1/me/* (library, recommendations)

weatherkit._where: Keys > key with WeatherKit enabled; Identifiers > Services IDs > service ID with WeatherKit

maps._where: Keys > key with Maps enabled (Maps IDs are for MapKit JS; the Server API uses the key directly)

cloudkit._where: CloudKit Console > container > Settings > Tokens & Keys > Server-to-Server Keys (upload the public key of an EC P-256 key: openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out eckey.pem)

apns._where: Keys > key with 'Apple Push Notifications service (APNs)' enabled

sign_in_with_apple._where: Keys > key with 'Sign in with Apple' enabled; client_id = Services ID (web) or bundle ID (native)

business_manager._where: Apple Business Manager > Preferences > API > Add (download the .pem key); scope business.api or school.api

search_ads._where: Apple Search Ads > Account Settings > API > Create API Client (upload your public key); team_id is the one shown on that page

news._where: News Publisher > channel > API keys (channel ID, key ID, key secret)

icloud._where: account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords (needs 2FA). apple_id is the iCloud email.
icloud.mail_from: optional sender address (must be an iCloud address or alias), defaults to apple_id
